tales.name: The Ports
tales.description: Each player keeps a Port in reserve. A Nomad or a Ship can build one; once built, it activates alongside its owner's Ship card, letting a Ship dock and depart or letting the whole Sea Region's shipping trade with it.

extraUnits.name: Port
extraUnits.description: A permanent harbor. Has no Civilization card of its own — activates whenever its owner plays their Ship card, but never on the turn it's built.

actions.name: Construct a Ship
actions.description: Place a Ship in the Port's own Sea space, if it doesn't already hold one. That Ship may also act this same turn.

actions.name: Trade with Ships and Ports
actions.description: Gain 4 Gold Pieces for each Ship and Port — any owner, including this one — in the same Sea Region.

nomad.name: Construct a Port
nomad.description: Remove the Nomad and place a Port on an adjacent, empty Sea space.

ship.name: Construct a Port
ship.description: Remove the Ship and replace it with a Port in its own space. Requires an adjacent Plains space.

tales.name: The Banks
tales.description: Each player keeps a Bank of their color in reserve. A Nomad adjacent to an allied City can build one on Plains or Forest, at a cost that climbs with every Bank already in the World; once built, any City with a Bank in play can Increase Taxes, scaling the same way. A Bank can't be converted or destroyed, except by an Economic Collapse.

extraUnits.name: Bank
extraUnits.description: A permanent vault. Has no Civilization card and no actions of its own — built by the Nomad's Construct a Bank action and cashed in on by the City's Increase Taxes action.

nomad.name: Construct a Bank
nomad.description: Replace the Nomad with a Bank. Requires a Plains or Forest space adjacent to an allied City. Costs 5 extra Gold Pieces for each Bank already in the World.

city.name: Increase Taxes
city.description: Requires controlling a Bank. Gain 1/2/3 Gold Pieces for a Mountain/Plain/Forest City, plus that same amount again for each Bank in the World.

tales.name: The Cathedral
tales.description: There's only one Cathedral in the whole World. A player with all 3 of their Temples in play can replace one with it; from then on it activates alongside their Temple card, converting enemy units and collecting taxes up to 2 spaces away instead of just adjacent. Whoever controls it at game end scores a hefty bonus — and if it's ever destroyed, anyone can build it again.

extraUnits.name: Cathedral
extraUnits.description: The single Cathedral in the World. Has no Civilization card of its own — activates whenever its owner plays their Temple card, but never on the turn it's built. Converts enemy units and collects taxes within 2 spaces instead of just adjacent.

actions.name: Convert Enemy Unit
actions.description: Convert an enemy unit within 2 spaces to your control. Only mobile units can be converted. Costs gold depending on the target: 2 for a Nomad, 3 for a Mountaineer, 5 for a Merchant or Ship.

actions.name: Generate Income
actions.description: Generate 2 gold for each unit within 2 spaces that you control and is not a Temple.

temple.name: Construct the Cathedral
temple.description: Replace this Temple with the Cathedral. Requires all 3 of your Temples in play, and that the Cathedral hasn't been constructed yet anywhere in the World.
